title: Network Quest Spec001 content authoring v1
$comment: Copyright 2026 John Capobianco. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Structural contract only; registry, source agreement, safe geometry, dialogue/quest reachability and release evidence require separate validation. This is not the save schema.
description: Validate a world metadata registry, a single authored record or a nonempty collection of authored records. Reuse $defs for build-time validation; metadata completeness never certifies scene, media or episode acceptance.

sourceQuantity.description: Source authoring preserves reviewed Mb/s and toy-level labels; neither extends the save-v1 reading unit vocabulary. Conversion to runtime readings is explicit, validated and never guessed.

condition.description: Pure data, no executable expressions. T015 bounds traversal, resolves references and checks reachability, cycles, optional/future dependencies and equivalent routes.

parameter.description: Reviewed parameter tree. Bare integers are dimensionless counts/codes only; physical measurements must be sourceQuantity. Numeric agreement with sources.json is a semantic check.

effect.description: Atomic, idempotent effects interpreted by domain reducers. Presentation, skip/replay, duplicate actions and restored learning history cannot independently apply rewards.

safePosition.description: Semantic restore anchors, not invented scene coordinates. Authored rooms map these IDs onto valid walk regions. Actual state eligibility is rechecked by the save coordinator.

characterIds.description: Named room encounters. The player and current recruited party can travel without inventing additional roster entries.

characterEntry.description: Named encounter locations from the specification; mobile player/recruited-party presence is not an extra character identity or a completed scene placement.

world.description: Complete identity/progression inventory only. No room, model, prop, dialogue, media, objective implementation or episode acceptance is certified by registry membership. documents lists only authored records that actually exist; empty is valid during foundation.

collection.description: Envelope for plural files such as profiles.json/objectives.json/characters.json. Every listed document reference resolves by kind and id inside this file; no empty authored collection.
